title: Regularized Density-to-Potential Maps in Density Functional Theory
exact_target: Specify when densities determine potentials and use rigorous regularization to handle nondifferentiable density functionals.

status_qualification: The chosen pure-state or ensemble functional, density space and potential dual space are essential. A regularized density-to-potential map is not silently identified with an unregularized map for every representable density.
